pages.visibleText: Skip to content GlobeFlow ERP Case Document Flow AI Evidence Modules View ERP case APPLE-STYLE ERP PRODUCT STORY From sales order to finance report, without duplicate entry. This version uses one realistic ERP transaction case instead of generic dashboard blocks. The page shows the actual business chain: customer, stock, quantity, delivery, invoice, payment risk, and AI evidence. Follow the transaction See AI proof Customer ACEMAX PTE LTD Sales Order SO-260617-0188 Amount SGD 42,800.00 Sales Manager / Sales Order Approved Sales Inventory Delivery Finance Reports Sales Order SO-260617-0188 Credit checkedStock reserved CustomerACEMAX PTE LTD CurrencySGD Terms30 Days OutstandingSGD 128,400.00 Stock CodeDescriptionQtyUOMAmount AX-100Industrial Control Harness248CTN42,800.00 AX-220Sensor Cable Assembly86PCS9,460.00 SRV-DELDelivery Service1LOT580.00 SO approved Stock reserved DO pending Invoice draft Credit limit check86% usedReview before next shipment Reserved stock248 CTNWarehouse WH-SG-02 Real document numbersSO, DO, INV, receipt, audit trail Real ERP fieldsCustomer, stock code, UOM, credit, quantity Real AI evidenceAnswer links back to business records TRANSACTION CASE One customer record drives the whole page. Instead of random metrics, every section uses the same sales order so the product story feels connected and credible. 01 Sales confirms the order Credit status, customer terms, item quantity, and pricing are visible before approval. Customer ACEMAX PTE LTD Order SO-260617-0188 Value SGD 42,800.00 02 Inventory reserves stock The stock line is not just a table row. It becomes fulfilment risk and delivery readiness. Stock AX-100 Reserved 248 CTN Warehouse WH-SG-02 03 Delivery prepares DO Delivered quantity can become invoice quantity, reducing manual retyping and mismatch risk. Delivery DO-260617-0092 Status Ready to pick ETA 18 Jun 2026 04 Finance sees the risk Invoice, outstanding amount, collection aging, and margin signals stay connected. Invoice INV-260617-0048 Outstanding SGD 128,400.00 Risk Medium SALES MODULE Approve with context, not guesswork. The sales user sees credit usage, outstanding invoices, item availability, and order margin before the document is approved. Credit limit warning appears before approval. Stock reservation is linked to the exact SO line. Sales order history remains traceable for audit. Approval PanelSO-260617-0188 Credit Used86% Gross Margin21.8% Available Qty312 CTN Approve allowed, but next delivery should be reviewed if overdue balance remains unpaid. INVENTORY MODULE Stock movement becomes a business signal. The page now shows actual warehouse, reserved quantity, committed quantity, and shortage status instead of abstract animation blocks. Stock code and UOM are visible. Reservation links to the source Sales Order. Warehouse readiness is clear for delivery staff. Inventory ReservationWH-SG-02 StockOn HandReservedAvailable AX-100312 CTN248 CTN64 CTN AX-220124 PCS86 PCS38 PCS Source: SO-260617-0188 · Customer: ACEMAX PTE LTD DOCUMENT FLOW The animation now explains the ERP chain. Each step is a real ERP document state, not just a decorative icon. 01QuotationQTN-260612-0031 02Sales OrderSO-260617-0188 03Stock ReserveAX-100 · 248 CTN 04Delivery OrderDO-260617-0092 05InvoiceINV-260617-0048 06Finance ReportAging + margin updated AI AGENT WITH EVIDENCE Ask a business question and see exactly where the answer came from. This is the biggest realism upgrade. The AI answer is supported by ERP records, not a generic chatbot sentence. Why is ACEMAX flagged as medium risk this week? ACEMAX is medium risk because outstanding invoices reached SGD 128,400.00, credit usage is 86%, and the current Sales Order depends on reserved stock scheduled for delivery tomorrow. EvidenceRecordStatus Outstanding balanceAR-AGING-260617128,400.00 Open sales orderSO-260617-0188Approved Pending deliveryDO-260617-0092Ready to pick Reserved stockAX-100 / WH-SG-02248 CTN Permission-aware answer4 source recordsTraceable ERP MODULE VALUE Less marketing. More operational clarity. Sales Approve order with credit, margin, and item availability in one view. Inventory Reserve stock by source document, warehouse, stock code, and UOM. Delivery Create DO from confirmed quantities and prevent invoice mismatch. Finance Connect invoice, payment aging, credit usage, GST, and margin. Report Turn live ERP status into management-ready summaries. AI Agent Answer business questions with source records and audit evidence. PREVIEW DIRECTION This now feels like a real ERP product page, not a fake SaaS template. The next upgrade would be replacing this HTML mock screen with actual ERP screenshots and masking sensitive customer data.
